# ChatGPT Subscription for DSH
English | 简体中文
Use your own ChatGPT subscription as a main-model provider in DeepSeek Harness (DSH). DSH keeps cont
rol of sessions, history and local tool execution. The plugin reuses DSH’s PiAiAdapter for message c
onversion and uses Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC) OAuth for the Responses API. It does not start a seco
and uses Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC) OAuth for the Responses API. It does not start a second agent.
Version **0.2.0** supports **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1**. Shared DSH packages now come from the host, tool isol
ation follows the new prompt and batch-execution APIs, and login lock timeouts explain the recovery
step. Existing authorization records remain readable. This is an independent integration, not an Ope
nAI-certified or officially endorsed product.
## What it does
- Adds the `ChatGPT subscription` provider (`openai-chatgpt`) to DSH. Available models are the inter
section of your account’s model directory and the pinned adapter’s supported catalog. No API key is

required, and the route does not fall back to API-key billing.
- Supports streamed replies, local fu
nction/custom tools, durable tool-history replay and image input for models whose catalog declares i

mage support. Images use DSH attachments and data URLs, not the Files upload API.
- Adds controlled
native `web_search` to the same main-model Responses request. The model decides when to search. This
route filters and blocks DSH’s local `web_search`; it does not replace the global search backend or

start a separate search agent. Other providers are unaffected.
- Shows `Using ChatGPT plan` and a `
Manage usage` link in the main conversation when this provider is selected. The notice does not disp

lay an account identity or remaining allowance.
- Enforces no-tool compaction, preserves trusted usa
ge and typed context-overflow errors, and rejects conflicting or untrustworthy tool identities befor
xt-overflow errors, and rejects conflicting or untrustworthy tool identities before local execution.
Other hosted capabilities, including image generation, Files/File Search, Code Interpreter and MCP,
are not enabled. Model access, native search, server-side parameter acceptance and service availabil
ity depend on your account, workspace and upstream service. Offline tests do not guarantee those ent
on your account, workspace and upstream service. Offline tests do not guarantee those entitlements.
## Requirements and compatibility

- **Node.js 24.9 or newer**.
- The supported host is **DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`**, with Cordis `4.1.0` and S
chemastery `3.19.0`. Shared host packages are peer dependencies and are not bundled. Independent pro

tocol libraries remain pinned. Older DSH releases are not supported by 0.2.0.
- The installer create
s a POSIX shell launcher. Windows installation, command shims and permissions have not been verified
a POSIX shell launcher. Windows installation, command shims and permissions have not been verified.

**Use the built release archive or the source installer.** No verified one-line GitHub install comma
nd is provided here. The repository is not a promise of npm-registry availability. The following com
mands refer to the source checkout, not an extracted runtime package.

r to resolve host peers, verifies archive copies with SHA-256 and creates a dedicated data directory
and launcher. It does not replace the DSH executable, start DSH or sign in. Package installation us
es `--ignore-scripts`. Existing destinations not managed by this plugin are refused.

le. It does not sign in or send model requests.
Then start DSH and select a model under `ChatGPT subscription` in the conversation model picker:

## Accounts, privacy and subscription limits
The OAuth implementation is generic. The distributed package contains no real account, subscription
grant, access token or refresh token. Each user creates their own authorization data by signing in.
The plugin does not import an existing Pi or Codex login cache.
Authorization is stored in the dedicated data directory through DSH’s local credentials service. It
is a local credentials file, not OS-keychain-encrypted storage. Do not publish, share or commit the
data directory, credentials, authorization URLs or unredacted status output. The native Web profile
and maintenance CLI share that store and its refresh lock.
Requests consume your existing ChatGPT plan limits. Credits may also be consumed if you allow them i
n ChatGPT usage settings. This plugin does not provide a free or unlimited subscription and does not
change your credits settings. An API cost estimate of zero is not a balance or an allowance check.
Prompts, selected history and supplied content are sent to OpenAI. `store:false` does not mean zero
data retention or enterprise Zero Data Retention (ZDR). Do not treat the integration or its offline
checks as official certification or a complete legal-compliance assessment.
